title: Argan and rosehip hair serum
subtitle: A lightweight oil blend for dry, frizzy, or colour-treated hair
excerpt: Argan oil and rosehip seed oil with cedarwood and rosemary essential oils, in a 30 ml dropper bottle. Apply a few drops to damp ends or as a finishing serum on dry hair. Makes 30 ml; keeps six months.
sourceNotes: Argan oil cosmetic properties: Kabiri, L. and Siri-Tarino, P. W., sourced via INCI database open reference. Rosemary essential oil for hair: limited clinical evidence; traditional use reference; avoid in pregnancy and with epilepsy. Cedarwood essential oil general reference. Rosehip oil hair use: general cosmetic formulation reference.

recipe.yieldDescription: 30 ml hair serum (~60 applications at 2 to 4 drops per use)
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make 30 ml at a time; rosehip oil is perishable.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Keeps six months in a sealed amber dropper bottle in the fridge. Rosehip oil oxidises readily; refrigeration is important. Discard if the serum smells sharp or rancid. The argan oil extends the blend's stability slightly.

glossaryTerms.definition: A lightweight plant oil applied to hair to smooth the cuticle, add shine, and reduce frizz. Argan oil is a popular choice because it is high in oleic acid and vitamin E, absorbs without leaving a heavy residue, and works on both dry and damp hair.

content.text: blend for dry or frizzy hair. Argan oil is the main carrier; rosehip adds linoleic acid for fine or colour-treated hair that benefits from a lighter oil. Cedarwood and rosemary essential oils provide scent and are traditionally associated with scalp and hair health. Apply sparingly: a little goes a long way.
Rosemary essential oil should not be used during the first trimester of pregnancy or by those with epilepsy. Cedarwood essential oil is toxic to cats.

content.text: Pour the argan oil and rosehip oil into the amber dropper bottle.
Fit the dropper cap and swirl to blend. Label with the date.

On damp hair after washing: apply two to four drops to the palms, rub together, and work through the mid-lengths and ends. Avoid the roots. Style as usual. On dry hair as a finishing serum: one or two drops only, worked through the ends to smooth frizz. Do not apply to the roots on fine hair.
Keeps six months in a sealed amber bottle in the fridge. Bring to room temperature before applying. Discard if the oil smells rancid.
